description: This file defines the ThemeDao class, which provides database access methods for theme-related data in the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for saving themes, retrieving themes by name, deleting themes, and fetching theme images, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builder.

classes.name: ThemeDao
classes.description: Data access object for theme-related database operations in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding module.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Persists a Theme entity to the database.

methods.name: getThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a Theme entity based on its name, with a default theme name fallback.

methods.name: getPartialThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a PartialTheme DTO for a given theme name.

methods.name: deleteThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Deletes a theme identified by its name.

methods.name: getImageByImageKeyAndThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a ThemeImage DTO for a specified image key and theme name.
